title: West-östlicher Divan
summary: "West-östlicher Divan" by Johann Wolfgang von Goethe is a collection of lyrical poems written between 1814 and 1819. The collection explores cultural exchange between Germany and the Middle East, blending Latin and Persian traditions, Christian and Muslim cultures.
